Official transcript from every institution attended. If not in English, upload the original and a certified English translation. A partial or unofficial record is accepted at application if you are still studying.
Include your name as in your passport, date of birth, contact details, education, work experience, research and publications, and other skills.
Statement of purpose of about 750 words: past work, preparation for your field, academic plans, career goals and why you chose the programme.
Three referees. You enter their details and they submit the letters directly; personal email addresses are not accepted. Academic referees are normally expected.
Official IELTS, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic or Cambridge C1/C2 score if available. Some degrees are exempt. You must meet the minimum before enrolment.
GRE or PGAT scores are not required but a strong score may help; valid for 5 years.
